value.author: Saurabh
value.title: Horrible
value.text:
Horrible experience to stay at these hotel..Please avoid for 5 main reasons.. 1)Rooms are very small 2)Lots of mosquitoes in the room… 3) Outside food is strictly not allowed here. And in-house food facility is very costly and tasteless 4)Breakfast is not at all good.. and very less for a single person 5)Guy who was responsible for managing breakfast was very stubborn , he will straight forward deny if you demand your already booked food and unnecessarily argue with you… I will never ever visit this hotel in my life.. This is my worst experience in any hotel in my life.

value.author: Sunil
value.title: An overall a very good property with your needs completed.
value.text:
I have booked this hotel for a short stay last month. The ambience was nice and calm. What I liked was the response from the front desk staff. He was polite and courteous. The check-in process was smooth and quick. The rooms were spacious. The room service was prompt. The bathroom was neat and clean and provided with toiletries. You can check with the hotel prior to booking. I had used book and pay later for booking this hotel. There is a restaurant in this property. The food was good. No issues. It's overall a good property.
— No issues.
